# Benjamin Tan
benjamin.tan@example.test | +65 6000 0002 | Singapore

## SUMMARY
Frontend Engineer with hands-on experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, and React. Proven ability to translate designs into reusable components and build accessible user interfaces that drive measurable improvements. Adept at collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver documented, reliable solutions while maintaining clear communication on technical trade-offs. Committed to writing automated tests and improving web performance through evidence-based decisions.

## EXPERIENCE

**Frontend Engineer** | Example Beacon Services (Singapore)
*Jan 2025 – Present*

*   **Accessible UI Development:** Built accessible user interfaces using JavaScript and TypeScript, resulting in a 26% improvement in team turnaround time.
*   **Component Architecture:** Translated designs into reusable React components and maintained clear documentation for technical and business reviewers to ensure maintainability.
*   **API Integration:** Collaborated with engineering and product stakeholders to integrate frontend features with REST APIs, ensuring reliable data flow.
*   **Quality & Performance:** Managed approximately 46 work items per month while implementing automated component tests using Jest to improve code quality and reduce technical debt.
*   **Stakeholder Communication:** Presented progress, risks, and technical trade-offs during fortnightly reviews, fostering trust through transparent reporting.

**Technical Assistant** | Example Cedar Innovations (Singapore)
*May 2024 – Dec 2024*

*   **Documentation & Processes:** Supported operational workflows by creating clear, step-by-step documentation in HTML, reducing manual preparation time by 21%.
*   **Problem Solving:** Investigated service requests and escalated issues with clear supporting evidence, demonstrating the ability to solve ambiguous problems collaboratively.
*   **Reporting:** Developed a simple reporting template that streamlined data collection and analysis for stakeholders.

## PROJECTS

**Frontend Engineer Practice Project**
*   Built a demonstration application using JavaScript, TypeScript, and React to showcase component reusability.
*   Implemented automated testing scenarios to validate functionality and recorded limitations for future iteration.
*   Presented design decisions and outcomes to a five-person peer review group, refining technical approaches based on feedback.

## EDUCATION

**Bachelor of Science in Information Systems** | Example Metropolitan University (Singapore)
*Aug 2020 – May 2024*
*   Relevant Coursework: Software Engineering, Databases, Cybersecurity, and Applied Analytics.

## SKILLS

*   **Languages:** JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS
*   **Frameworks & Tools:** React, Next.js, Git, Jest
*   **Core Competencies:** REST APIs, Web Performance Optimization, Accessibility (a11y), Design Systems, Technical Documentation, Cross-functional Collaboration

job_description:
# Frontend Engineer



**Company:** Example Meridian Labs (fictional)  

**Location:** Singapore  

**Employment type:** Full-time  

**Seniority:** Entry



## ABOUT THE ROLE



Example Meridian Labs is seeking a Frontend Engineer to join a multidisciplinary technology team. The successful

candidate will turn operational and customer needs into reliable, maintainable solutions. This role

works closely with engineering, product and business stakeholders, values clear documentation and

expects evidence-based decisions. The position offers ownership of meaningful work while maintaining

appropriate review, security and quality controls.



## RESPONSIBILITIES



* Build accessible user interfaces.

* Translate designs into reusable components.

* Integrate frontend features with rest apis.

* Write automated component tests.

* Review code and improve web performance.

* Communicate progress, risks and technical trade-offs to relevant stakeholders.

* Maintain clear documentation and contribute to team planning and reviews.



## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* JavaScript

* TypeScript

* React

* HTML

* CSS

* REST APIs

* Git

* Jest

* Clear written and verbal communication

* Ability to work collaboratively and solve ambiguous problems



## PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Next.js

* accessibility

* design systems



## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



In the first six months, the successful candidate will understand the existing environment, deliver

well-tested improvements and build trusted working relationships. Success is measured through

quality, reliability, responsible delivery and useful outcomes rather than activity alone.
